lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three discernible horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The clusters show a higher density and greater pixel diameter in the mid-lateral section compared to the dorsal-most regions.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a rectangular grid pattern, most visible in the region directly posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the mid-flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the superior edge and a dark shadow profile on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin exhibits irregular notches and jagged margins, deviating from a smooth anatomical curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Six small teleost fish (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface and trailing edge of the pectoral fin. Significant caustic light refraction patterns from the water surface are overlaid across the dorsal and lateral skin surfaces.
